svg.text: FIRST north-window-0 · supported renewal trial
Actual 1000 raw · sill 850 · head 2850 · 35 joint + 60 frame = 810 clear · mm relative FIRST FFL
1 · Elevation / guard and frame
Brown: raw + 27 finish · blue: 35/95 frame profiles · green: full independent grille
Orange: capture-pad allocations · magenta: 40 strut sections and guard fixing axes
2 · Section / supported outward sequence
Basket retreats before guard moves; frame continues until its back face clears strut ends.
3 · Protected first release
Open both leaves under the retained grille; support and release the stays.
Erect the L barrier; insert and latch the two struts through grille gaps.
Capture guard and brackets; release and remove the brackets from protected exterior access.
4 · Frame exchange
Retreat the basket; withdraw the captured guard past the retained strut ends.
Capture frame before releasing jamb/head screws; retain the sill pan and struts.
Withdraw frame, replace, renew seals/pan transitions, refit leaves and full guard.
Boundary
Illustrated envelopes are authored trials; no product, rig, weather or tolerance pass.
Full clamps/slings, joins, barrier delivery, material, roof and physical tests remain open.
Source-bound local geometry only · see north-export-occurrence-result.md and the access/exterior/frame reproducers · WIP / no IAS export pass
